title: Restore all missing static images/assets so MCP download matches live preview

requirements.text: Add all missing static image assets referenced by the frontend into the repository under the frontend public assets folder structure (including /assets and /assets/generated) so that a fresh MCP download includes them and the site renders without broken images.
acceptanceCriteria: All image files referenced by src attributes in the current frontend codebase exist on disk under frontend/public at the expected paths (e.g., /assets/... and /assets/generated/...).
Running the app locally shows no broken image icons on Home, Products, Category, and Subcategory pages.
A re-run of the MCP download command produces a folder that includes these image files.

requirements.text: Audit and fix all frontend image references to ensure they use correct absolute public paths (e.g., /assets/... or /assets/generated/...) and do not depend on any external/temporary URLs; update any incorrect paths so images load in both local dev and production builds.
acceptanceCriteria: No in the app points to an external URL for core site visuals (hero, logo, category banners, placeholders).
All pages that render category images (ProductsPage, CategoryPage, SubcategoryPage) successfully load images using the product taxonomy image paths.
Home page hero image loads from the local public asset path.

requirements.text: Add a lightweight frontend-only validation/check during development (documentation or a simple developer note/utility) that lists the required static asset paths used by the app to prevent future missing-asset exports.
acceptanceCriteria: There is a clear, repo-local way for a developer to see which static asset files are required by the current UI (e.g., a documented checklist or a small utility script/runbook).
The checklist/utility includes at least the hero image, the logo, category banner images, and product placeholder images.

constraints: Keep the existing single-actor Motoko backend architecture unchanged.
Do not modify any files under frontend/src/components/ui or any paths listed as immutable in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
Use English for any user-facing text.
nonGoals: Creating a downloadable ZIP export from within the chat (must be done via MCP CLI after assets are restored).
Adding new product features or changing site structure/routing beyond what is required to fix missing assets.
